components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sage-filled pill CTA, e.g. 'See my collection' or the nav 'Say hi'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f6d59; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Quicksand', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(79,109,89,.25); transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f6d59; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Soft Card
components.description: The signature rounded, softly-shadowed card used for the hero frame, stat list, work/writing rows, and photo plates.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fffdf8; border: 1px solid #eadcc7; border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(79,109,89,.18); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: 'Baloo 2', ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; color: #4a3b2e; } .ds-card p { font-family: 'Quicksand', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #7a6852; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Tag Chip

narrative.overview: The site is a cozy little room you visit, not a resume rendered as a webpage: the hero is a hand-illustrated isometric scene sitting right beside the name, and the whole system carries that warmth through — sage green, blush pink, and cream, fully rounded pill buttons and soft-shadowed cards, a chunky rounded display face. It's a direct homage to 2000s Cyworld/minihompy personal-room profile pages. This is the third full visual identity this project has carried in one session, chosen deliberately from a served set of options after two more conventional directions were tried and set aside. The room illustration is genuine hand-built SVG — there is no image-generation tool in this environment, so every visual element is real vector code, not a synthetic image.
keyCharacteristics: Illustrated, not abstract: the hero's signature is a real drawn isometric room, not a metaphor rendered in typography or a background pattern.
Rounded everywhere: pill buttons, large soft-cornered cards, a circular nav mark — zero sharp corners, the direct opposite of every previous world this project carried.
One warm neutral pair plus three soft accents: cream ground and warm-brown ink carry the page; sage, blush, and blue stay secondary or decorative.
Honest, not fabricated: 'Today's mood' is genuine personality copy, not a fake live statistic.

rules.name: The Illustration Owns Blush and Blue
rules.body: Blush pink and rain-cloud blue are the room illustration's own material and are not reused as general UI accent colors.

rules.name: The Soft-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface uses the same blurred, sage-tinted shadow recipe — no zero-blur shadows, no mismatched shadow colors.

dos: Do keep every corner rounded — pill on interactive chrome, 1.5rem on cards, never sharp.
Do keep every card shadow the same sage-tinted, blurred recipe.
Do keep Blush and Blue confined to the room illustration itself.
Do keep personality copy like 'today's mood' genuine, never a fabricated statistic.
donts: Don't add a sharp corner anywhere.
Don't reintroduce a flat, shadowless card.
Don't spend Blush or Blue as a button/link/badge color outside the illustration.
Don't fabricate a live number that isn't real.
